connector.name: Webhook Studio
connector.registryDescription: Keyless webhook endpoints: capture, wait, replay, forward, and generate types from real traffic.
connector.summary: Hosted at webhook-studio.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.webhook-studio, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. A keyless read+replay token from POST /api/start (ws_anon_...), or a full-access API key from your dashboard (ws_live_...). See https://webhook-studio.com/mcp/setup
